v1_hooks.prompt: chat.message mutates output.message and output.parts before durable prompt admission
v1_hooks.prompt_authorship: chat.message has no origin field; client.session.get returns immutable session parentID, parts expose synthetic, and autorun classifies synthetic as automation, non-synthetic child as subagent, non-synthetic root as user, and lookup failure as automation; API/plugin root prompts remain indistinguishable from TUI input
v1_hooks.stop_continuation: client.session.promptAsync POSTs a message to /session/{id}/prompt_async and returns 204
v1_hooks.stop_notice_fallback: client.tui.showToast POSTs a visible warning to /tui/show-toast when continuation is unavailable
v1_hooks.pre_compact: experimental.session.compacting receives sessionID and mutable context/prompt output

model_prompt_paths: the task tool creates a session with parentID before prompting it; shell writes a synthetic user part directly and does not trigger chat.message, so built-in model tools do not create a root non-synthetic prompt
compatibility: V1 object entrypoints remain supported in OpenCode 1.18.29 and newer. The prompt bridge feature-detects client.session.get and fails unknown authorship to automation. The Stop bridge feature-detects client.session.promptAsync; if absent, a received denial is shown through client.tui.showToast with an explicit non-enforcement warning. Daemon-unavailable and timeout paths still fail open.
